newsitem.title: POLAND: Lucent Polish unit wins cellular contract.
newsitem.headline: Lucent Polish unit wins cellular contract.

text.p: The Polish subsidiary of Lucent Technologies was awarded a two-year contract to supply digital cellular phone operator Polkomtel SA with long-range teletransmission radio networks, Polkomtel said in a statement.
It said Lucent Technologies Network Systems Poland SA would be the sole supplier of such networks over the next two years.
Polkomtel, which markets its system under the GSM Plus brand, in one of Poland's two operators of the cellular phone GSM system.
Polkomtel and Lucent would not disclose the value of the contract.
